title: Elastic KV Cache for LLM Serving: A Working Reclamation Mechanism, and Why Chunked Prefill Already Closes the Gap
selection_reason: Builds a CUDA virtual-memory mechanism that dynamically lends prefill-reserve memory to the KV pool, then reports a useful negative result showing that smaller chunked prefill often recovers more KV with nearly equal latency. This is valuable for avoiding unnecessary complexity in serving-memory designs.
